level_data.method: Static record-level parser: strings, primitive arrays, class metadata and object references only; no .NET deserialization or original code execution.
level_data.identity_policy: Use source asset gmNNN/soNNN as lookup key; preserve internal Save.level even when it differs. Do not deduplicate by Save.level.
level_data.fixed_flag_note: fijo is not a boolean; many strings encode additional compound state. Preserve exact strings.

code_recovery_boundary: Original Unity objects and serialized data are available. IL2CPP strips C# method bodies from ordinary Unity asset files; recovered scripts or placeholders are not evidence of original gameplay logic. Scene names, component names and serialized values are original; stated roles inferred from names/fields must be labeled as inference.

piece_alias_resolution.note: All names map to base geometry, but compact-index and color-suffix interpretations are inferred. Original runtime color/state logic remains unverified.
